subject: Engagement option analysis — SOC 2 + ISO retainer (2028)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: BrightTree Assurance <contact@brighttreeassurance.com>; Ellis & Co. <audits@ellis-co.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Engmt options request — SOC 2 + ISO retainer (2028)

Hi Laura / team at Ellis —

We're starting intake for our 2028 assurance coverage window and want to gather firm-level engagement options for a combined SOC 2 (Type II) + ISO 27001 annual retainers. Attached is a short scope doc that outlines our current topology (hosted + dedicated + private deployments), data handling concerns, and a rough timeline. Key asks:

- High-level pricing model (retainer vs per-engagement) and estimated not-to-exceed for the year
- Proposed approach to combined SOC2 + ISO assessments (one engagement vs two coordinated engagements)
- Typical timeline for readiness -> Type II reporting and ISO certification cadence
- Evidence collection model (remote evidence collection, snapshot cadence, required Redwood engineering time)
- Any standard exclusions or assumptions (travel, infra access, redlines)

Can you send a one-page summary + a sample SOW or fee schedule by EOD Tue Jul 13? We're planning an internal shortlist the week of Jul 19 and expect to kick off contracting in early Aug.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Rachel Kim
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
---
Attachment: redwood_inference_audit_scope_2028.docx (7 KB)
From: Laura Hartman <l.hartman@brighttreeassurance.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightTree Commercial <contact@brighttreeassurance.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Engmt options request — SOC 2 + ISO retainer (2028)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the scope doc — we've reviewed the topology and can propose two sensible options:

1) Combined annual engagement: single retained engagement that covers both SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 surveillance / recertification activities. This reduces duplicate evidence collection and assigns a dedicated lead auditor familiar with hybrid cloud architectures. Estimated annual retainer: $145k–$165k depending on sample sizes and number of endpoints.

2) Modular: separate SOC 2 engagement with ISO as a follow-on recertification. Lower upfront cost but higher total administrative effort. Estimated: SOC 2 retainer $95k–$110k + ISO $45k–$60k.

We attach a short proposal and sample SOW (BrightTree_proposal_2027Q4.pdf). BrightTree has worked with two other LLM-focused vendors in the last 18 months and our lead has direct experience with private VPC/on-prem combos.

We can have a draft MSA and SOW to you by the end of next week if you want to move quickly. Happy to set up a 30m walkthrough.

Best,
Laura Hartman
Principal, BrightTree Assurance
Attachment: BrightTree_proposal_2027Q4.pdf (118 KB)
From: Ellis & Co. <audits@ellis-co.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Engmt options request — SOC 2 + ISO retainer (2028)

Rachel —

Appreciate the detailed scope. Ellis & Co. can offer a lower fixed retainer model and a modular evidence collection process that minimizes engineering time by leveraging an evidence portal and automated collectors for standard artifacts (configuration, access logs). Example pricing: $110k flat retainer for combined coverage with a limited travel allowance; alternate: $90k SOC 2 + $30k ISO.

We attach a one-page summary (Ellis_proposal_summary.pdf) and a short FAQ about our evidence portal. We're happy to run a brief demo next week.

Regards,
Ellis Audit Team
Attachment: Ellis_proposal_summary.pdf (42 KB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Engmt options request — proposals from BrightTree & Ellis (internal matrix)

Team — forwarding both proposals for internal alignment. Key differentiators I see so far:

- BrightTree: higher estimate but unified approach, strong experience with hybrid infra and a single lead auditor (less context-switch for infra/serving/runtime).
- Ellis: lower all-in cost, stronger automation for evidence gathering (portal), likely lower Redwood engineering hours but may require two discrete engagement artifacts for ISO certification planning.

I've attached a quick comparison matrix (proposal_matrix_2027-07.xlsx) with recommended evaluation criteria:
- Total annual cost (incl travel)
- Single-auditor continuity (yes/no)
- Evidence collection burden on infra/eng
- Timeline to Type II report / ISO recertification
- References / prior LLM infra customers

Ask: please review the matrix and rank cost vs operational friction by EOD Mon Jul 18. I'd like to short-list to one firm and ask them for contract redlines the week of Jul 19. If either of you want a 20m call before then I can set one up.

Rachel
Attachment: proposal_matrix_2027-07.xlsx (28 KB)

Thanks Rachel — good summary. My read: BrightTree's combined model aligns better with our goal to reduce duplicate effort across SOC2 and ISO. Two quick asks before procurement issues a PO and MSA redline:

1) Reference checks: please gather two recent references from LLM/platform customers (especially where they handled private deployments).
2) Confirm their approach to scoped exclusions (we need explicit language about customer-managed on-prem components and any carve-outs).

If BrightTree can provide references and confirm the exclusions language, authorize procurement to proceed with a draft MSA + SOW. Karthik / legal to lead the redlines; cc'd.

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Decision: proceed with BrightTree — request for MSA + kickoff

Hi Laura —

Following internal review, Redwood will proceed with BrightTree for our combined SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 retainer. Please: 

- Send a draft MSA and SOW that reflect the combined engagement model and include an assumptions section for on-prem/VPC (we will flag any carve-outs in redlines).
- Provide two customer references (preferably LLM or infra-heavy) and the proposed lead auditor bio.
- Attach a mutual action plan & an estimated PO so our procurement team can process a retainer PO.

I've attached the mutual action plan template and a PO request PDF we're likely to use. We expect legal to review and turn around redlines within 5 business days.

Thanks and looking forward to the kickoff — can we tentatively schedule the kickoff week of Aug 8?

Rachel Kim
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
